lessons: The check-stage requisition review renders live plan and Context bytes. A test fixture that fakes smaller section-20 or Context sizes makes the pytest pass, but the gate still fails.

bug-gate-grammar's pinned Embedded Context (tickets.py, gates.py, test_tickets.py, test_gates.py) plus section 20 renders to 165093 chars. The max-effort bound with headroom is 160000, so the pinned partition overflows.
report-inbox-triage's pinned Embedded Context includes squatch/triage.py, which contains the engine delimiter '[squatch-data:'. The render is refused no matter how large the prompt is.
Both fixes mean moving files out of Embedded Context into measured on-demand. The ticket forbids that as a contract change, so the ticket's partitions must be re-planned in section 20 upstream.
reason: The ticket pins Embedded Context partitions that overflow the max-effort render bound and include a delimiter-carrying file. The only fix changes the pinned contracts, which the ticket's Definition of rejected forbids.
